description: List the GripForge Library locker (characters, enemies, weapons, props, textures, HUD, buttons, binds). Filter by kind and/or game style. Every item carries `rank` {score/100, grade A–D, reasons}: fitness for a GripForge game; sort=rank lists the best fit first.

sort.description: newest (default) or rank: best fit first

style.description: Game look id or alias (e.g. souls-like, open-world-adventure)

subtype.description: Subtype within the selected kind, e.g. quadruped under creatures.

target.description: Platform for the rank budgets. Defaults to mobile.

name: gripforge_library_list
